Manage the tokens the daemon's TCP listener accepts.

Every call to the daemon over TCP needs a token. Make one here, on the
daemon's host, and give it to `dicer remote create` on the machine that
will use it. The daemon serves the API over TCP only when server.listen
is set in its configuration.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`dicer token create`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/dicer_token_create" >}}) | Make a token for the daemon's TCP listener. |
| [`dicer token delete`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/dicer_token_delete" >}}) | Delete one or more tokens, or all of them. |
| [`dicer token list`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/dicer_token_list" >}}) | List tokens. |
| [`dicer token rotate`]({{< relref "/docs/reference/cli/dicer_token_rotate" >}}) | Give a token a new secret. |
